metadata.source: Surveyed table axes and front edge; original box placement retained through authored rigid table-frame coordinates.

appearance.appearance_note: 2026-10-02 stage 2: de-lit, physical-scale table albedo built from real external frames (visual_matching/work/texture), planar UVs (replaces the photo projection); wall/skirting albedo rectified from real frames; scan clutter Observed_primary_Furniture hidden (left-corner artifact). Albedo scale values calibrate render brightness to the real external camera under the stage-2 lights.

white_box.note: 2026-10-02 stage 2: real box is white and partly clipped; data asked for linear gain ~2.4-2.8 (albedo > 1), clamped to neutral 0.95. Visual material only.

provenance.description: RealSense D435I camera calibrated from its factory intrinsics, aligned metric table depth, and confirmed box placement; appearance fitted to the September 24 reference. Metres, Z-up.

lighting.description: Fitted to real external RealSense shading (eps!=0,6): front key tube behind the camera (unchanged geometry), soft overhead panel above the far half of the table, soft fill from -x (image right), plus RTX ambient. Intensities are renderer appearance estimates, not photometry.

calibration.extrinsics_source: 2026-11-11: camera-only pose refinement against the connected RealSense RGB feed and read-only follower joint snapshot. Matched box and gripper landmarks with factory intrinsics locked; mean reprojection error 18.62 to 3.68 pixels. Robot mount, joint mapping, objects, and lens unchanged. Evidence: outputs/camera-alignment/fit.json and comparison.png. This is a visual alignment fit, not an independent depth calibration. Previous pose: 2026-10-02 visual_matching/work/ext_cam2/native/r1a.
calibration.note: RTX OpenCV pinhole lens model preserves measured fx, fy, cx and cy. Extrinsics estimated from aligned metric depth and box rim correspondences.
